question: A question for Odacchi… or rather, a suggestion!! A while ago, you made a "Voice Actors SBS" where people could ask the voice actors questions, right? Then, I think that Katsuhisa Hōki-san, the voice actor for the newest addition to the Straw Hat Pirates, Jinbe, should also get to do it, what do you think? –
answer: Oooh, that sounds nice~. That was a really long time ago lol. From Vol. 52 where it started with Luffy's VA Mayumi Tanaka-san to Vol. 64, the Straw Hat VA Corps did 9 SBSes total. So, we'll be taking questions for Katsuhisa Hōki-san, voice actor of Jinbeee~!! He's a really cool old dude who's a bit of a dandy just like Jinbe! Ask away!! Right then, today's SBS ends here!! Next time, it's Vol. 100~!! NewWorld - Artur from [https://thelibraryofohara.com The Library of Ohara].
name: Pitterer
